thread:
maria: heads-up — noticed a ~10-14% drop between ingest token counts and invoice preview for tenant acme-co after the routing throttle change this morning. console shows sampling rate flipped to 0.1 for their route at 05:09 UTC
aj: hmm, was that the new ingest-side throttling + sampling we rolled out to reduce peak write qps? i thought it only affected raw ingest, not final aggregation
sunil: it was supposed to only tag events with sample_rate and let postproc rescale. maybe the postproc multiplier didn’t get applied for streaming batches created during the deploy window
maria: exact symptom: ingest shows 1.2M tokens, invoice preview 110k tokens. tag sample_rate=0.1 present on events, but aggregation UI shows tokens_without_scaling in the raw table
taylor: can you paste an example event blob? curious if sample_rate is string vs float — that caused a bug last year
maria: sure — paste below
```
{"tenant":"acme-co","tokens":1000,"sample_rate":"0.1","route":"model-v2","ts":1728800500}
```
aj: ah — sample_rate is a string here. the postproc multiply path expects number, so JSON decode left it as string and we filtered it out in the safety pass (fastpath).
sunil: oh no. that's in the ingest serializer that normalizes http headers into tags. the header came through as text; we should have cast earlier. but why only for some batches?
engbot: deploybot: postproc-service v2.14 deployed at 05:07 UTC (canary=10%)
taylor: oh — canary only covered primary pipeline, streaming shadow path still on v2.13 which didn't rehydrate sample_rate properly. the 10% of traffic hitting v2.14 had proper numbers, the rest didn't. explains partial delta
maria: actionable: hotfix serializer to coerce sample_rate to float and backfill 2h of events where tag present but aggregation skipped scaling. Also need to mark invoices as provisional for those tenants that hit the canary window
aj: agree. small followups: 1) add invariants in aggregation that assert if sample_rate present and tokens < threshold then log audit 2) surface sample_rate column on invoice-preview UI so sales/CS can see sampling effect
sunil: minor thought: adding sample_rate to invoice-preview could be noisy. maybe only show it when sample_rate != 1 or add a tooltip explaining "sampled events have been upscaled for billing"
taylor: UX idea: hide the raw sample_rate behind a little badge with hover detail + link to an internal explainer. we should avoid scaring customers with numbers without context.
maria: agreed. but internal console (ops view) should be raw. customers can get simplified view. also we need an internal alert when sample_rate!=1 and invoices change >5% after backfill
aj: quick patch plan — 1) hotfix serializer (5m) 2) trigger backfill job with dry-run + counted diff (15m) 3) patch postproc to coerce types (5m) 4) add audit log + small dashboard panel for sample_rate anomalies (30-60m runway)
taylor: i can own the dashboard panel + tooltip copy. sunil you want serializer/postproc?
sunil: taking serializer & postproc. will push hotfix to canary first and monitor. will also add an internal feature flag to treat sample_rate as authoritative only when source=="edge-ingest"
aj: for the backfill, make it idempotent and tag backfill-run with correlation id so invoice previews can be tied to run. also ensure invoice-preview has a "provisional" badge when backfill pending
maria: note for follow-up: this surfaced a deeper debate — should we store sample_rate as a typed field in the event schema instead of tags (ie sample_rate: number). if we migrate, we can avoid a class of issues like this
taylor: +1 to typed schema. but migration path will take weeks. for now let's triage with coercion and UI signals
engbot: incidentbot: creating ticket #INF-4792 "sample_rate string ingestion -> aggregation scaling miss" assigned to @sunil, severity P2
maria: thanks. one more thing — routing policy change that triggered throttle needs a rollback window note. product suggested permanent conservative throttle but we should coordinate with billing so no surprise invoice changes for customers in the next invoice cycle
aj: I'll message product and billing. also recommend we add a telemetry counter for "events_with_sample_rate_string" and emit to the debug logs so we can spot other clients sending strings
sunil: on it. pushing canary now. will report back with canary metrics and the dry-run backfill diff
maria: awesome. once we confirm diffs <1% we can mark invoices final and close. if >1% will require comms. thanks team :thumbsup:
